title: Encoding the initial configuration
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a finite alphabet, let $E$ injectively code optional $[0m[0m\Gamma$ symbols as blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, and suppose the blank symbol is coded as the all-blank block. Let $e:\{0,1\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an embedding, $M$ a finite-state $k$-tape machine over $\Gamma$, and $x$ a binary input. The initial configuration of the binary block-code simulator on $x$ equals the encoding of the initial configuration of $M$ on the letterwise $e$-image of $x$.
